name: Edit A Campaign Template Content
description: Edits a defined content area of a custom HTML template. [See docs here](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/campaign-content/set-campaign-content/)

configurable_props.name: campaignId
configurable_props.label: Campaign ID
configurable_props.description: The unique ID of the campaign

configurable_props.name: templateSections
configurable_props.label: Template sections
configurable_props.description: Content for the sections of the template. Each key should be the unique mc:edit area name from the template.

configurable_props.name: plainText
configurable_props.label: Plain text
configurable_props.description: The plain-text portion of the campaign. If left unspecified, we'll generate this automatically.

configurable_props.name: html
configurable_props.label: Plain text
configurable_props.description: The plain-text portion of the campaign. If left unspecified, we'll generate this automatically.

configurable_props.name: url
configurable_props.label: URL
configurable_props.description: When importing a campaign, the URL where the HTML lives.

configurable_props.name: variateContents
configurable_props.label: Variate contents
configurable_props.description:
Stringified object list of content options for [Multivariate Campaigns](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-multivariate-campaigns/). 
      Allowed keys are archive, template, content_label, plain_text, html, and url.
        Each content option must provide HTML content and may optionally provide plain text. 
        For campaigns not testing content, only one object should be provided.
